name: Adaeze O.
title: Survived 6 months of daily use
body: I work in A&E at LUTH and these tops go through industrial wash almost daily. Six months in, the colour is still rich and the stitching is intact. Best scrubs I have bought in Nigeria.

name: Dr. Mensah K.
title: Great fit, true to size
body: Ordered a large and the fit is perfect — not boxy like the imported ones. The hidden pocket is genius for my phone during ward rounds.

name: Nurse Funke A.
title: My whole unit switched
body: Bought one set to try, then our whole ICU team ordered through the wholesale programme. The yoga waistband is so comfortable for 12-hour shifts.

name: Dr. Ibrahim S.
title: Solid coat, embroidery is neat
body: Good heavy fabric that looks premium. The embroidered name came out very clean. Delivery to Abuja took 4 days as promised.

name: Zainab B.
title: Finally, a hijab that stays put
body: As a theatre nurse this is a game changer. It does not slip even under a cap and mask for hours, and it is cool enough for our weather. Jazakum Allahu khairan Zeon!

name: Dr. Chidi E.
title: No more back pain
body: I am on my feet all day in surgery. These clogs genuinely changed my life — grippy on wet floors and my lower back pain is gone.

name: Dr. Amaka N.
title: Tailored beautifully
body: At last a lab coat that fits a woman properly. Got so many compliments on my first day wearing it. Sizing guide was accurate.

name: Theatre Team, Eko Hospital
title: Good bulk order
body: Ordered 60 caps for our theatres. Quality is consistent across all of them and they survived autoclaving well.

name: Blessing T.
title: Good value
body: Comfortable and true to size. Wish there were more colours in 2XL, but the quality for the price is excellent.

name: Dr. Kunle A.
title: Perfect set
body: Top and trousers match perfectly and the fabric feels premium. Delivery to Ibadan was quick.

name: Dr. Ngozi P.
title: Looks expensive
body: Patients keep complimenting my coat. Heavy quality fabric, neat finishing, pockets everywhere.

name: Midwife Sarah J.
title: Night-shift essential
body: Theatre is freezing at 2am and this jacket is my saviour. Soft, warm, and the zip is strong.

name: Emeka D.
title: Great pockets
body: Cargo pocket fits my phone and the waist is comfortable. Slightly long for me but easy to hem.

name: Matron Grace O.
title: Smart and modest
body: Very smart tunic, well cut and modest length. Our ward has ordered matching sets for everyone.

name: Nurse Tunde B.
title: Comfortable
body: Very comfortable for long shifts and easy to clean. Runs slightly large — consider sizing down.

name: Dr. Fatima K.
title: Legs feel fresh
body: No more swollen ankles after call days. Good compression without being too tight.

name: Aisha M.
title: Stays in place
body: Wore it for a 10-hour shift and adjusted it zero times. Cool fabric, beautiful finish.

name: Dr. Seun L.
title: Good base layer
body: Smooth under scrubs and the thumbholes are a nice touch. Wicks sweat well.
